title: Syntomic relative dimension and its candidate source open
statement: Let $g:P\to T$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] and $d\in\mathbf N$. Say that $g$ is syntomic of relative dimension $d$ if it is flat [def-weil-flat-morphism], locally of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation], and for every algebraically closed field $\Omega$ [def-weil-field] [def-weil-algebraic-closure] and $t:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to T$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum], the geometric fibre $P\times_T\operatorname{Spec}\Omega$ [def-pc-fibre-product] is a local complete intersection over $\Omega$ [def-sfb-local-complete-intersection-over-field] and is pure of dimension $d$ [def-weil-pure-dimension]. Define the candidate open $L_d(g)$ to be the union of all source opens $U\subseteq P$, with their open immersions $\iota_U:U\to P$ [def-weil-open-immersion], such that $g\circ\iota_U$ is syntomic of relative dimension $d$. This definition is made for every $g$, without asserting that the union itself has this property. Empty sources, empty fibres, and empty unions are allowed.
